title: Representation of positive linear functionals on C_c(X, ℝ) from Theorem 4.12
statement: Assume RieszPositive (Simon Thm 4.12) for spaces in universe u: for every locally compact Hausdorff space Y in universe u and every ℝ≥0-linear λ : C_c(Y, ℝ≥0) → ℝ≥0, there is a Radon outer measure ν on Y with λ(h) = ∫_Y h dν̄ (ν̄ = caratheodoryMeasure ν) for all h ∈ C_c(Y, ℝ≥0). Let X be a locally compact Hausdorff space in universe u, and let Λ : C_c(X, ℝ) → ℝ be ℝ-linear with Λ(f) ≥ 0 whenever f ≥ 0 pointwise. Then there is a Radon outer measure μ on X with Λ(f) = ∫_X f d(caratheodoryMeasure μ) for every f ∈ C_c(X, ℝ).
lean_statement: RieszPositive.{u} → ∀ (X : Type u) [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] [LocallyCompactSpace X] (Λ : C_c(X, ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ), (∀ f : C_c(X, ℝ), 0 ≤ f → 0 ≤ Λ f) → ∃ μ : OuterMeasure X, IsRadonOuterMeasure μ ∧ ∀ f : C_c(X, ℝ), Λ f = ∫ x, f x ∂caratheodoryMeasure μ
